# Vendored classroom-tool libraries

These dependencies are checked into the repository so the classroom tools remain usable offline and do not depend on a CDN.

- `spin-wheel-5.0.2/` — [CrazyTim/spin-wheel](https://github.com/CrazyTim/spin-wheel), MIT License, version 5.0.2.
- `timepicker-ui-4.6.0/` — [pglejzer/timepicker-ui](https://github.com/pglejzer/timepicker-ui), MIT License, version 4.6.0; the wheel plugin is registered from its local ES modules.

The original MIT license notices are included in each directory. The local application code integrates these upstream distributions without changing their vendor files.
